topics.caution: The explanation could make ચારુબાલાની લીટી 'હું એકલી જ જાણે બધાંની દાસી' sound like a joke or a natural state, teaching the child that all housework is naturally the mother's job alone.
topics.guidance: Explain ચારુબાલાની ફરિયાદ as the play means it — she feels unseen and overburdened by being asked for one lost item after another; keep the real_life_example about a family sharing housework, not a repeat of 'the mother alone does everything' as normal.

topics.caution: Lines like 'આ ઘરમાં આવીને તમારાં બધાંની સુખસગવડ સાચવવા જાત ઘસી નાખી' could be explained as simply what a wife or mother does, reinforcing the stereotype instead of showing her specific complaint of getting no help.
topics.guidance: Keep the explanation centered on ચારુબાલાની feeling of being taken for granted, and on સંતોષની ભલમનસાઈ that still leaves her doing everything alone — not as a general description of what wives normally do.

topics.caution: The stage direction notes ક્ષિતિ — a doctor who spent twenty years abroad — wears bangles, a colourful sari and a bindi, 'ડોક્ટર થયાનું કે વીસ વર્ષ વિલાયતમાં કાઢ્યાનું એકે લક્ષણ નથી'; an explanation could turn this into commentary that an educated, working woman is expected to look different (western dress) and it is surprising she does not.
topics.guidance: Present ક્ષિતિ simply as a doctor and family member who dresses as she chooses; do not add a comment suggesting her traditional appearance is at odds with, or surprising for, her profession or her years abroad.

topics.caution: સંતોષની લીટી 'તારે પરણ્યા વગર નહીં ખબર પડે' assumes an unmarried woman cannot understand married life; teaching prose could restate this as a general truth rather than one character's passing remark.
topics.guidance: Keep this as સંતોષના પાત્રની બોલી, part of the playful sibling banter between him and ક્ષિતિ — not as a lesson or fact the child should take away about marriage or about women.

chapter_level.guidance: Across the play, ચારુબાલાની ઘરકામની ફરિયાદ and ક્ષિતિની સ્વતંત્ર, અપરિણીત, ડૉક્ટર તરીકેની ઓળખ are both threads the text carries with its own respect, without moralising on either — teach them the same way: ચારુબાલાનો થાક વ્યાજબી છે, અને ક્ષિતિની સ્વતંત્રતા સહજ છે; neither becomes a joke, and neither needs 'fixing' or extra commentary from the explanation.
